study type: Retrospective service data analysis and prospective observational study
cohort: Pregnant women, including 17,736 from a retrospective cohort (2004-2008), 826 with gestational diabetes (2014-2019), and 361 with ≥1 gestational diabetes risk factor from a prospective cohort
finding: Random plasma glucose at 12 weeks, and fasting plasma glucose or HbA1c at 28 weeks gestation identified women with hyperglycemia at risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
